result.reason: The redline appropriately covers Customer affiliates and contractors and permits transfer to a successor through the existing assignment provision. However, it does not expressly limit termination of this hosted/subscription licence to an uncured material breach; instead, it permits revocation upon any expiration or termination authorized by paragraph 4, whose grounds are not limited here. It also leaves the separate operative statement that the licence “shall be revoked,” creating inconsistency, and does not address perpetual and irrevocable treatment if any licence is paid-up. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve the platform-use restrictions and unrelated commercial terms.
